title: Liquid metal word
summary: The name in rounded, sharp-edged liquid metal; the camera travels along the letters close, then pulls back to the whole word.

params.name: line
params.default: Brand videos, made by your coding agent.

params.name: weight
params.description: extra stroke on the letters, in px at 400px type: 0 keeps the face's own weight

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add text-mask --name my-text-mask
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-text-mask/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-text-mask/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
when: the opening or close on the name
